name: Slavery
overview: Scripture addresses the reality of slavery with clear moral boundaries, condemning the kidnapping and selling of people as punishable by death (Exodus 21:16) and requiring just treatment of servants (Exodus 21:20). While slaves were often taken from surrounding nations (Leviticus 25:44), the gospel brings a higher calling to freedom and unity, proclaiming liberty to captives and emphasizing that in Christ there is no distinction between slave and free (Luke 4:18; Galatians 3:28). Believers are exhorted to stand firm in the freedom Christ provides and not to return to bondage (Galatians 5:1).
